The observer sees the cycle start, input sample, task overruns, starts and ends,
output sample and cycle end (CycleHooks::on_compiled_phase): status, tasks.stats,
io.read and the allocation count work as for STBC. The retained values are checkpointed
in the format the interpreter writes (M2). Online change (the module runs in its image in
the program region), breakpoints, stepping and Live Values (M3) are served on the chip and
on the computer by the same cycle and debugger code.
